newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mostly higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mostly higher on Friday as bullish sentiment in the soybean market encouraged local investors to buy corn, traders said.
The spot March contract expired down 430 yen at 16,600 yen with 150 lots of deliveries.
Others were 190 to 420 yen higher, with the benchmark January 1998 contract up 190 yen at 15,750 yen per tonne. The day"s volume was 54,998 lots.
Active buying by individual investors emerged from the opening, reflecting the soybean market"s strong tone and the weaker yen against the dollar, traders said.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.74-1/2 per bushel at 0905 GMT,
The spot March of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.64-1/2 at 0905 GMT, against $7.65-1/2 at Thursday"s close.
